evidence.title: Risk from Inadequate Sleep and Irregular Schedules
evidence.summaryText: NASA research describes how irregular schedules, shifting work demands, and disrupted sleep environments can reduce total sleep and affect crew performance.
evidence.limitations: General spaceflight research context only; not individualized medical diagnosis, duty-fitness clearance, or schedule authorization.

evidence.title: Seven Ways Astronauts Improve Sleep
evidence.summaryText: Educational NASA mission guidance highlighting consistent sleep schedules, light/dark cues, quiet rest environments, and noting sleep interruptions.
evidence.limitations: Educational habit context only; does not prescribe hours, lighting doses, caffeine timing, or medications.

evidence.title: NASA Standard Measures
evidence.summaryText: Defines core physiological, behavioral, and sleep-wake observation domains collected across spaceflight research campaigns so distinct indicators stay contextualized.
evidence.limitations: Research campaign framework; CrewSignal is an independent manual-entry prototype and does not adopt full study cadence or clinical validation.

evidence.title: Five Hazards of Human Spaceflight
evidence.summaryText: Frames spaceflight health risks across radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, gravity fields, and hostile closed environments.
evidence.limitations: High-level mission hazard framing; does not establish autonomous diagnosis or EVA readiness.

evidence.title: NASA Human Research Roadmap — Risks
evidence.summaryText: Catalogs documented spaceflight human-system risks and research gaps, informing conservative separation between observation logging and clinical claims.
evidence.limitations: Research gap inventory; hazard documentation does not authorize an individual clinical recommendation.

evidence.title: Isolation Standard Measures Manuscript (IAC 2022)
evidence.summaryText: Describes sleep diaries and distinct psychological/cognitive instruments used in analog isolation studies, motivating period-only sleep logging and honest custom mood scope.
evidence.limitations: CrewSignal uses a custom single-item mood scale (crewsignal-mood-v1) rather than POMS/PANAS or validated cognitive batteries.

evidence.title: CDC NHANES 2021–2022 Laboratory Procedure Manual — GLU-L-MET-508
evidence.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
evidence.summaryText: Establishes the unit conversion factor used in CrewSignal: mmol/L × 18.02 = mg/dL (and exact reciprocal for mg/dL to mmol/L).
evidence.limitations: Supports unit conversion arithmetic only; not a clinical threshold, sampling protocol, or mission-applicability rule.

evidence.title: NIST SI Units: Temperature
evidence.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
evidence.summaryText: Defines the exact Celsius/Fahrenheit equations used in CrewSignal: F = C × 1.8 + 32 and C = (F − 32) / 1.8.
evidence.limitations: Unit conversion standard only; does not validate thermometer site compatibility or clinical fever cutoffs.

actions.title: Review sleep routine
actions.applicability: Use your approved mission procedures for individual decisions.
actions.limitation: This comparison describes your entry; it does not assess fitness for duty or prescribe hours, medications, caffeine, lighting doses, or schedule changes.
actions.triggerSummary: Triggered when a compatible Main sleep entry differs from your personal sleep reference.
steps: Check the recorded sleep period and whether any sleep window included awake time.
Review your approved rest schedule for recent shift changes or irregular timing.
Note interruptions or environmental context for your available mission support.

actions.title: Check measurement context
actions.applicability: Applies whenever measurement method, resting context, or input units are missing or differ from your reference.
actions.limitation: Improves log comparability only; does not interpret values clinically.
actions.triggerSummary: Triggered when an entry has method "Not specified" or differs from active reference context.
steps: Confirm the instrument method and resting/post-exercise context if known.
Keep original entered units and timestamps intact when reviewing conversions.
Only compare observations recorded with compatible methods and contexts.

actions.title: Mission procedures
actions.disabledReason: Clinical treatment or mission-specific procedure guidance remains disabled unless applicable reviewed mission content is supplied.
actions.applicability: Requires applicable reviewed content from your mission operations team.
actions.limitation: No clinical triage, dosing, or unreviewed medical procedure is included in the default prototype.
actions.triggerSummary: Disabled until reviewed mission-specific procedures are configured.

helpUnconfigured.body: Use your approved onboard procedures and available mission support. This prototype cannot assess urgency or contact support.
steps: Consult your approved onboard medical and flight-crew procedures.
Use your available mission support channel outside this prototype if needed.
Help stays available offline without completing a check-in or baseline.
helpUnconfigured.limitation: No diagnosis, clinician directory, phone number, chat channel, or Send delivery is configured in CrewSignal.
offlineFacts: Cached research summaries are available offline.
No check-in or reference is required to open Help.

helpConfiguredFixture.body: Example content for navigation and offline access testing only. Real mission guidance requires supplied applicable reviewed content before enabling it.
steps: Verify the local cached procedure version and check date before relying on offline copy.
Follow your team-supplied onboard procedure document rather than this test placeholder.
helpConfiguredFixture.limitation: Test fixture only: no approved medical steps, clinician contact, or authority are fabricated.
offlineFacts: Example procedure card · Test fixture is cached locally.
Cached research summaries are available offline.

heart_rate.name: Resting heart rate
heart_rate.purpose: Track resting heart rate observations with explicit measurement method and context so comparisons match like with like.
instructions: Enter beats per minute (bpm) from your instrument or manual count.
Use the time the reading was observed.
Record measurement method and resting context when known.

blood_pressure.name: Blood pressure
blood_pressure.purpose: Record systolic and diastolic blood pressure together as one paired observation in mmHg.
instructions: Enter both systolic and diastolic mmHg values from one measurement.
Use the time the reading was observed.
Record cuff method and body context when known.

blood_glucose.name: Blood glucose
blood_glucose.purpose: Record optional blood glucose entries with explicit mg/dL or mmol/L unit selection and normalized review.
instructions: Enter the value and unit from your instrument.
Units: mg/dL or mmol/L.
Use the time the reading was observed.
Record method and context when known.
This app converts concentration units for review. It does not supply a measurement procedure.
Follow your approved mission and device instructions.

body_temperature.name: Temperature
body_temperature.purpose: Log oral or site-specific body temperature in °C or °F while preserving entered unit, precision, and site/method.
instructions: Select °C or °F before entering the reading.
Record the measurement site/method when known; incompatible methods remain distinct.
Use the observed mission time.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.purpose: Record sleep duration as a period ending on a mission day, keeping optional sleep windows separate from estimated asleep time.
instructions: Enter hours and whole minutes (0–59) of estimated time asleep.
Entering 0h 0m explicitly logs Reported no sleep; leave blank if unrecorded.
Only compatible Main sleep periods enter the sleep reference.

mood.name: Mood
mood.purpose: Capture a custom 1–5 ordinal self-report alongside sleep context without diagnostic interpretation.
instructions: Select one option from 1 Very low to 5 Very good.
Mood starts unselected; no default score is chosen.
Notes are optional and excluded from reports unless selected.

bodySystems.name: Sleep & cognition
bodySystems.summary: Self-reported sleep and mood only; cognition is not directly measured.
bodySystems.limitation: Self-reported duration and mood ordinal history do not replace cognitive testing or clinical evaluation.

bodySystems.name: Cardiovascular
bodySystems.summary: Manual pulse and BP observations; method/context determine comparison eligibility.
bodySystems.limitation: Manual spot checks do not provide continuous telemetry or flight-clearance assessment.

bodySystems.name: Musculoskeletal
bodySystems.summary: Not assessed; no bone-density or muscle-status inference.
bodySystems.limitation: Routine prototype inputs contain no musculoskeletal sensor or imaging data.

bodySystems.name: Immune context
bodySystems.summary: Context only; do not infer immune status from temperature.
bodySystems.limitation: This prototype's routine observations do not provide a supported immune assessment.

bodySystems.name: Nutrition & metabolism
bodySystems.summary: Optional glucose spot entries only; missing data is not overdue or a diagnosis.
bodySystems.limitation: Without intake logs or continuous metabolic markers, nutrition and metabolism are not broadly assessed.
